name: 44310 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44310 (Akron) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44310 (Akron) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44310 (Akron) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
